The room shell each spec produces, per seed, frozen so a shape change is reviewed as a diff against these numbers rather than described. Regenerate with python -m rfw_w.scenes.preparation.emit_room_shell_baseline only when the change is intended, and read the diff. T is now published: seed populations are reweighted across four families.
Generated by python -m rfw_w.scenes.preparation.emit_room_shell_baseline. The unified shell policy chooses a shape family (rect/l/u/t) and the notches within it, and random draws come from named substreams seeded by 'SEED:shape' rather than by the integer seed directly -- so both the dimensions and the outline moved when families landed, which is expected and is why this file was regenerated in that change.
Regenerated again when the bite became a drawn band (NOTCH_FRACTION_BAND) instead of the fixed 0.25 fraction. That time every seed's width, depth and height were deliberately unchanged -- the size draws sit on the integer seed and were not touched -- so the diff was 0 moved footprints, 0 moved heights, 0 moved families and 40 moved notches. A reader regenerating this file should run the same check: if a size moves when only the shape was meant to, that is the regression, not the review.
